name: USB Flash Drive
instruction: Create a 3D model of a USB flash drive. It should have a rectangular body with a removable cap.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a USB flash drive.
The body of the flash drive is rectangular.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The length of the body is longer than its width.
The cap should be proportionate to the body.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The cap should align properly with the body when placed on.
The body should be stable when the cap is removed.
Object distance and contact: There should be no gaps between the cap and the body when the cap is on.
The cap should not overlap with the body when removed.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The model includes a removable cap as instructed.
